quest.title: The Rumored Alchemist
quest.description: You arrive at Timaeus' alchemy store in Mondstadt one day to stock up on adventuring supplies. But here, you encounter someone altogether unexpected...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x275, Mora x17050, Adventurer's Experience x8, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Speak to the young lady at the store

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like Timaeus isn't here today...
(Customers!?)
Oh! Um... Pardon me, are you looking for Timaeus?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No no! Just strange for him to not be around. Paimon always sees him standing here.
I see. He was called away by Albedo a little while ago. I was called over to attend to the store.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I'm Sucrose, Albedo's assistant. If you have any alchemy-related queries, you could always ask me. I'd... do my best to help.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I... Actually, I'm not very good at this kind of thing.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: M—My apologies, I don't get out too often. I'm usually in the laboratory, where there aren't many others to talk to.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: If you need any help, just call my name. If not, I'll... I'll be reading a book — over there. Mm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Mm-hmm, thanks! No worries, we're all clued up on the basics of alchemy, aren't we, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Mm-hmm, no need to trouble you.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #{NICKNAME}... Hey, aren't you the legendary Traveler? The one who repelled Stormterror?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I've heard so many stories about you! Always wanted an opportunity to research you up close!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, what do you mean, "research"!?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ah! Sorry, don't mind me, what am I saying...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Still, you'd definitely be able to help Albedo. It is you after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's that name again! "Albedo." Is he also an alchemist in Mondstadt?

choices.text: Not a name I'm familiar with.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Apologies, I never introduced him. Albedo is the Knights of Favonius' Chief Alchemist. He's also Timaeus' and my teacher.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Paimon's only ever seen Timaeus teaching alchemy. So that means... Albedo is a teacher-teacher?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Yes, he's dedicated himself to investigating the truth of this world, and has made many an important breakthrough.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: We often get alchemists coming to Mondstadt from all over Teyvat, seeking his help. They say that the subtlest of guidance from Mr. Albedo helps them to solve the most unfathomable of problems.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Paimon didn't know he was such a big deal!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Mm-hmm. Still, it seems that he's encountered a problem in his research recently. Every time I see him, he has a concerned look on his face.

choices.text: I'm not sure someone as smart as him could use my help.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm sure that Albedo would love to hear about your incredible exploits. I know it would bring him lots of new inspiration.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Albedo is a true gentleman. He'll be sure to pay you back in equal measure for helping him out.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I don't see why not. Testing the limits of living beings' capabilities is one of Albedo's areas of research after all.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Albedo and Timaeus will be conducting research in the mountains right now. I'd love to take you both to see him, but somebody has to attend to the store.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm afraid you'll have to go to the entrance to the pass and look for him by yourselves. Look out for a refined gentleman with the presence of a true scholar, and... umm...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: ...Sorry, that's the best I can do. You'll have to do your best.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, stop worrying! We got this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, Paimon doesn't need any help in that department. But if Albedo wants to pay Paimon back for helping him, a few Mora might settle the score. Tee-hee!

choices.text: My knowledge of alchemy stops at basic crafting.
Think I might have heard of him.
And I don't even charge for autographs.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ah! Thank you!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Huh? D—Do I look nervous?

talks.objective: Head to the entrance of Dragonspine

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: My apologies, I don't really know how else to describe him...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: If I could sketch you his portrait I would, but my pencil strokes are no match for his.

talks.objective: Get close to the two people talking

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: S—Sister Rosaria, so here you are! Choir practice is about to—

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: I've told you already, I don't go in for that kind of thing. I've got more important matters to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: But... this event has commemorative significance. The church hopes that all sisters will be present...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: "Hopes"!? That's odd, 'cause I don't recall a "fulfill the hopes of others" clause in my job description.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I— I mean sure, but...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: But what? You're the event organizer, aren't you? Do you not find it the least bit odd...?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Wh—What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: This far out from Mondstadt, at this hour? Even if you set out right now, I'll wager you'd still miss the opening ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Who knows? Maybe this is someone's grand plan to make a fool out of you.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Huh!? Th—That can't be! People aren't like that!

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Hah! Evidence decides what people are like, not your feelings. *sigh* Maybe you're a little too trusting of other people.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Don't fret, nobody's gonna blame you if you go back empty-handed. I can't imagine anyone else was delusional enough to think I was gonna show up.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: But if you dally any longer, you really won't make it.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...You're right! It's a very important commemorative event. If I'm late, then... R—Right, I've got to get going!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, seems like that sister's an expert in making people believe anything she wants.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: I thought I heard something — who are you, and why are you eavesdropping?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'd better watch out! She seems like a dangerous villain... Or a trickster at best.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Oh really? I'm a member of the long-standing Favonius Church. You're an eavesdropping pixie from who knows where, and you think I'M the trickster?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, she heard that!? But Paimon was whispering so quietly...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: And as for this outlander you seem to be following... Huh — so it's you.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: The Honorary Knight that saved us from Stormterror. Well, then, given your status, I won't press you on your reasons for eavesdropping.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Otherwise, depending on your answer, I could've arrested you on the spot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? Do the sisters of Mondstadt have the authority to arrest people now?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: We can't go turning a blind eye to hidden dangers can we? Why shouldn't Sisters have a sense of justice?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, that doesn't sound right. But Paimon can't think of a good comeback...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Let's talk about you. What are you doing in the mountains?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: If it's him you're after, I made a point of noting his tracks.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Many people have made their way up after the snowstorm. Let's hope they're still there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... are you also looking for him?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: No, this is just a professional habit of mine. I sensed elemental traces in these tracks. Never hurts to be vigilant.

choices.text: As far as sisters go, you're fairly mysterious.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: I couldn't care what you think. Come on then, I'd like to see what he's up to anyway.

choices.text: We're investigating the truth of this world.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: But you're only a traveler, I doubt you have any great skill in alchemy.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Whatever, I had a notion of who you were seeking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sucrose is a whole lot less nervous once she gets talking about alchemy and research, huh. Is that what all researchers are like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's go and look for Albedo.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Rosaria said there were elemental traces in the tracks. They should show up pretty clearly with Elemental Sight!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Looks like Timaeus isn't here today...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: (Hm? Wait, are these two...)

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #Oh! Um... Hello, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Pardon me, are you looking for Timaeus?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No no! Just strange for him to not be around. Paimon always sees him standing here.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I see. He was called away by Albedo a little while ago. I was called over to attend to the store.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: If you need any help, just call my name. If not, I'll... I'll be reading a book — over there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Mm-hmm, thanks! No worries, we're all clued up on the basics of alchemy, aren't we, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, no need to trouble you.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I guess it's no surprise coming from the one who repelled Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Actually, since it's you... I bet you're someone who'd be able to help Albedo.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's that name again: "Albedo." You and Timaeus mentioned him the last time we met, right? Is he also an alchemist in Mondstadt?

choices.text: Not a name I'm familiar with.
Think I might have heard of him.
